title: rosa afzeliana var. pseudohaberiana
intro: Rosa afzeliana var. pseudohaberiana, commonly known as the fragrant rose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce pain and swelling, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Rosa afzeliana var. pseudohaberiana include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and promote wound healing, making it a popular herbal remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
